analysis: Retrospective nine-cell range/translation-noise sensitivity, no parameter selection

grid.odom_sigma_time_rule: translation scale * 0.03 * sqrt(dt_seconds) per XY component

fixed.calibration: Oct17 P1 per-link offsets from merged PR31, subtract once, no refitting
fixed.observations: Original B 1-second keyframes, four range-bin medians, no additional filtering or node selection
fixed.optimizer: Unmodified archived solver from PR31; same Odom-aligned initialization each solve; max_nfev=300; ftol/xtol/gtol=1e-7
fixed.robust_loss: Inherited pseudo-Huber, delta=1 on standardized range residual only; changing range sigma also changes physical robust transition scale
fixed.evaluation: Original endpoint stop+[2,7) half-open interval, componentwise median estimated antenna XY; four stationary windows per run identical to PR32

metrics: endpoint difference to manually measured antenna endpoint (no measurement uncertainty quantified)
stationary scatter about median and first-last displacement, not accuracy
range residuals in meters, overall and by link/phase, not position truth
per-step Odom translation/yaw residuals, not motion truth
trajectory displacement from frozen (1,1) graph, not position error
optimizer success, status, nfev, optimality and objective (objective not comparable across noise scales)

reference_audit.confirmed: Survey axes x forward/y left; bag Odom child_frame base_footprint; recorded endpoints refer to antenna center
reference_audit.unverified: Surveyed approximate chassis center equals base_footprint origin; gyro_link transform; upstream Odom IMU use; initial antenna position; intermediate poses
reference_audit.policy: Do not estimate or change extrinsics using endpoint performance; preserve inherited assumption and label all results conditional

interpretation: These two runs have been inspected previously. This is diagnostic development sensitivity, not held-out testing, an optimum search, independent replication, or an online benchmark.
failure_policy: Retain finite nonconverged iterates with explicit failure flag, do not accept as successful accuracy result; record exceptions without replacing a grid cell
stop_rule: Run exactly the nine specified cells for each run; do not add cells or change weights based on endpoint outcomes
not_allowed: fit alignment, heading, time offset or lever to endpoints
modify raw data or previous results
